owner: main (C does not edit UI or E assertions)

consumer.defaultResponse: unchanged old shape; no scopeReview key
notes: observedAt may differ between the two reads

verified.title: 已核对冻结原文
verified.copy: 以下内容与当时发送时一致。

scope_changed.title: 当前只读选择与冻结时不同
scope_changed.copy: 冻结原文未展示；历史记录、工作与回答仍可查看。

missing.title: 冻结原文文件缺失
missing.copy: 无法读取当时的原文，也不会用当前来源替代。

unverified.title: 无法核对冻结原文
unverified.copy: 原文或回执校验未通过，未核对内容不会展示。

reasons.project_changed: 所属项目与冻结时不同
reasons.selection_narrowed: 当前允许路径比冻结时更窄
reasons.selection_broadened: 当前允许路径比冻结时更宽
reasons.selection_validity_changed: 选择有效期与冻结时不同

render.withheldSourceCount: 显示『另有 N 条冻结来源未展示』，N 最大 64
render.partialBadge: 仅在 scopeReview.partial 为 true 时显示只读提示
render.authorization: 不渲染为权限、允许执行或重试许可
render.reasons: 最多 7 条去重原因，按数组顺序展示

doNotRender: readable counts (not present in public DTO)
raw allowed/excluded path values from diagnostics
authorization none as any kind of approval
testHints: default response has no scopeReview key
opt-in body equals default apart from observedAt and scopeReview
narrow selection: state scope_changed, empty sources, reasons include selection_narrowed
validity drift on a verified body: reasons selection_validity_changed, partial false
missing artifact: state missing, partial true, withheldSourceCount 0
strict query: only exactly one scopeReview=1 accepted; other values/repeats 400
